from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import shutil, tempfile, os

pptx = Path('/home/user/Desktop/31_2.pptx')
img = Path('/home/user/Desktop/none.png')
media_name = 'ppt/media/none.png'
slide_name = 'ppt/slides/slide2.xml'
rels_name = 'ppt/slides/_rels/slide2.xml.rels'
ct_name = '[Content_Types].xml'

P = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main'
A = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'
R = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
REL = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'
CT = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types'
MC = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006'
P14 = 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main'
P15 = 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2012/main'
for prefix, uri in [('p',P), ('a',A), ('r',R), ('mc',MC), ('p14',P14), ('p15',P15)]:
    ET.register_namespace(prefix, uri)
ET.register_namespace('', REL)

cm_1 = 360000
# Location is top-left of the slide canvas unless the UI later moves it.
x = 0
y = 0

with ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as zin:
    slide_xml = zin.read(slide_name)
    rels_xml = zin.read(rels_name)
    ct_xml = zin.read(ct_name)

slide_root = ET.fromstring(slide_xml)
sp_tree = slide_root.find(f'.//{{{P}}}spTree')
if sp_tree is None:
    raise SystemExit('slide2 spTree not found')

# Remove an earlier identical inserted picture if this script is rerun.
for pic in list(sp_tree.findall(f'{{{P}}}pic')):
    cNvPr = pic.find(f'./{{{P}}}nvPicPr/{{{P}}}cNvPr')
    if cNvPr is not None and cNvPr.get('name') == 'none.png':
        sp_tree.remove(pic)

ids = []
for el in sp_tree.iter():
    val = el.get('id')
    if val and val.isdigit():
        ids.append(int(val))
shape_id = max(ids or [1]) + 1

rels_root = ET.fromstring(rels_xml)
existing = {rel.get('Id') for rel in rels_root.findall(f'{{{REL}}}Relationship')}
rid_num = 1
while f'rId{rid_num}' in existing:
    rid_num += 1
rid = f'rId{rid_num}'
ET.SubElement(rels_root, f'{{{REL}}}Relationship', {
    'Id': rid,
    'Type': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/image',
    'Target': '../media/none.png',
})

pic = ET.Element(f'{{{P}}}pic')
nv = ET.SubElement(pic, f'{{{P}}}nvPicPr')
ET.SubElement(nv, f'{{{P}}}cNvPr', {'id': str(shape_id), 'name': 'none.png'})
ET.SubElement(nv, f'{{{P}}}cNvPicPr')
ET.SubElement(nv, f'{{{P}}}nvPr')
blip_fill = ET.SubElement(pic, f'{{{P}}}blipFill')
ET.SubElement(blip_fill, f'{{{A}}}blip', {f'{{{R}}}embed': rid})
stretch = ET.SubElement(blip_fill, f'{{{A}}}stretch')
ET.SubElement(stretch, f'{{{A}}}fillRect')
sppr = ET.SubElement(pic, f'{{{P}}}spPr')
xfrm = ET.SubElement(sppr, f'{{{A}}}xfrm')
ET.SubElement(xfrm, f'{{{A}}}off', {'x': str(x), 'y': str(y)})
ET.SubElement(xfrm, f'{{{A}}}ext', {'cx': str(cm_1), 'cy': str(cm_1)})
ET.SubElement(sppr, f'{{{A}}}prstGeom', {'prst': 'rect'}).append(ET.Element(f'{{{A}}}avLst'))
sp_tree.append(pic)

ct_root = ET.fromstring(ct_xml)
has_png = any(el.tag == f'{{{CT}}}Default' and el.get('Extension') == 'png' for el in ct_root)
if not has_png:
    ET.SubElement(ct_root, f'{{{CT}}}Default', {'Extension': 'png', 'ContentType': 'image/png'})

slide_out = ET.tostring(slide_root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)
rels_out = ET.tostring(rels_root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)
ct_out = ET.tostring(ct_root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)

tmp = pptx.with_suffix('.pptx.tmp')
with ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as zin, ZipFile(tmp, 'w', ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    skip = {slide_name, rels_name, ct_name, media_name}
    for item in zin.infolist():
        if item.filename in skip:
            continue
        zout.writestr(item, zin.read(item.filename))
    zout.writestr(slide_name, slide_out)
    zout.writestr(rels_name, rels_out)
    zout.writestr(ct_name, ct_out)
    zout.writestr(media_name, img.read_bytes())
os.replace(tmp, pptx)
try:
    Path('/home/user/Desktop/.~lock.31_2.pptx#').unlink()
except FileNotFoundError:
    pass
print('added', media_name, 'to slide 2 as', rid, 'size EMU', cm_1, cm_1)
PY
